quest.title: The Yaksha's Wish
quest.description: The words of a certain Yaksha seem to have been left behind on a stone tablet...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Adventurer's Experience x6

dialogues.speaker: Ruin Tablet
dialogues.text: "My name is Bosacius, one of the Yakshas. I followed my Lord to fight against evil and contend with pestilence. Yet though we Yakshas had great might, we were bound by our duties, and stained by them..."

dialogues.speaker: Ruin Tablet
dialogues.text: "...Liyue is now at peace, but of our number, none but Alatus and I remain. And for my part, I wish to depart, to be done with this world."

dialogues.speaker: Ruin Tablet
dialogues.text: "...My wealth I leave here, sealed by my arts. If you are fated to do so, take them as you please..."

talks.objective: Look for clues to opening the stone tablet
